signal.key_findings: eval_score=-442.5, 5/20 terminated (25%), ep_len=837. Generated reward +0.518/step but original env reward -0.827/step. Shaped reward is positive while true objective is negative — the agent is rewarded for behavior the environment penalizes.
signal.component_anomalies: gated_forward dominates at 63.2% signed share (64.4% magnitude). Gate is closed ~18-39% of steps (per-step nonzero=61%, ep-level active=81.6%). height_penalty is dead: 19.4% active rate, near-zero contribution. upright_bonus 22.5% share is secondary.
signal.training_dynamics: No temporal dynamics data available. 0/20 episodes are early-terminal (<150 steps), meaning terminations occur mid-run. Fixed eval seeds show wide score range [-1622, -1.1].
signal.signal_quality: The gate_lower=0.3 threshold may be too strict: 39% of per-step observations have gate=0, killing the forward progress signal. The agent achieves positive shaped reward (+0.518) despite poor true performance (-0.827), indicating the reward components don't align with the environment's success metric.

args.key_findings: Eval score=-442.53 (range: -1621 to -1.14), 5/20 terminated (25%), ep_len=837. Generated reward per episode sums to ~+998 (gated_forward=736, upright_bonus=262), but original_env_reward=-0.83/step drives the negative eval. Shaped reward is strongly positive yet misaligned with true objective.
args.component_anomalies: height_penalty nearly dead: active_rate=19.4%, episode_sum_mean=-0.16 — the quadratic hinge with w_h=0.5 rarely triggers. gated_forward active_rate=81.6% means gate=0 in 18.4% of steps, killing forward signal. upright_bonus always active (100%) and contributes 22.5% signed share — a substantial posture subsidy independent of locomotion.
args.training_dynamics: No early-termination episodes (<150 steps). All terminations occur later, consistent with eventual falls. The policy learns to generate forward velocity when upright (gated_forward dominates at 63.2% signed share) but the gate threshold at up_z=0.3 creates a dead zone where no progress incentive exists, leaving 25% of episodes to drift into termination.
args.signal_quality: Gate cliff at up_z=0.3: below this, all forward progress reward vanishes. No smooth incentive to recover posture once the gate closes. Height penalty is too low-magnitude (mean=-0.0004/step) to matter. Lateral penalty is mild (mean=-0.02/step) and may not deter sideways drift that precedes falls. The strong upright_bonus (0.5*up_z) may be exploited by standing still.
